scope: Author-side corrections captured in the authorized curation workspace. No central FazGraph write was made.

repairs.finding: HTML comments generated in MDX are rejected by the actual MDX parser.
repairs.correction: Use JSX comment syntax in the reconciliation generator and regenerate all affected reference pages.
repairs.gate: reference-mdx-validation.json: 58 compiled pages, zero parser/link errors at the final fixed point.

repairs.finding: Thirteen concepts had no application excerpt because inherited locator terms were empty or named an implementation that had changed.
repairs.correction: Read the actual product code, rewrite the mechanism and terms, replace stale NiFi FlowController with SocketProtocolListener, and add the Loki memberlist wiring.
repairs.gate: verify_curation.py now requires an application excerpt for every concept.

repairs.finding: The sanitized APISIX artifact initially retained the remote original hash as its canonical artifact hash.
repairs.correction: sha256 resolves the published sanitized bytes; remote_sha256 and original_artifact_sha256 preserve original provenance.
repairs.gate: freeze-receipt.json records zero mismatches across all 799 HTTP 200 source records.

lesson_candidate: A source file, an HTTP 200 and a keyword in a framework do not prove an application mechanism. Keep parser, per-application excerpt, artifact integrity, author semantic classification and independent approval as separate gates.
